rows.note: This is the all-purpose copula for identifying someone or something, linking a noun predicate, and stating the time.

example.english: This happens to be my phone.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 bou6 din6 waa6

rows.note: Use 有 for existence and for measurements expressed as an amount possessed, especially age or duration such as having three hundred years of history.

example.english: There appears to be a doctor here.
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 jau5 wai2 ji1 sang1

rows.note: Use 喺 instead of 係 when the subject is located at a place.

example.english: I happen to be at home right now.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Put 緊 after the verb to express an action that is in progress, rather than translating English is separately.

example.english: I happen to be watching TV right now.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 tai2 gan2 din6 si6
